research_notes: Food Bank of North Alabama is a secular hunger-relief nonprofit serving 11 counties in North Alabama based in Huntsville, AL. Organization demonstrates professional development and fundraising infrastructure with dedicated Development Director and Coordinator roles. Executive leadership (CEO) has 10+ years tenure and professional fundraising background. Board includes doctorate-holding members indicating significant donor networks. Development team appears to handle both individual giving and grants. Search results consistently referenced staff/board page (foodbanknorthal.org/staff-and-board/) but complete board roster and additional development staff not captured in search snippets. Organization rated 4/4 stars on Charity Navigator indicating strong philanthropic performance.
